The six paired source reviews report complete coverage of 682 original source rows: 438 accepted, 110 corrected, and 134 held. This pass checked formatting and assembly only; it did not redo those source decisions.

The existing parser mapped all 544 individually checked normalized approved rows. Panel STC/NOCT values were checked through the dedicated panelRatings path. Grouped evidence emitted technical fields for all 164 IDs in this approved evidence set.

All 12 Continuous output power rows remain in final evidence; the eight merged rows preserve all source temperature conditions. All eight VA-apparent values remain verbatim alongside their W values. No VA-to-W conversion occurred.

The maximum-PV system-mode table retains each voltage-mode/input-range pair. Separate maximum input and output voltage limits remain distinct; the supported 120 V and 240 V charging modes remain held, not collapsed into one rating.
VEC085 gauge and length retain per-cable scope and the dual set of two red/black cable sets. The OUPES connector carries its one-pair/20-foot scope while the separate quantity-scope row remains held.
The EG4 cross-source dimension hold preserves H×W×D and the manufacturer metric dimensions; the MATE3s fit hold retains the manufacturer guide remote-monitoring qualifier.
